{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:31:06.420
    | text      = Minnesota shooting reveals Democrat domestic terror.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:31:10.859
    | text      = Here it is.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:31:15.299
    | text      = The quiet suburbs of Minneapolis were shattered early this morning by a cold calculated act
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:31:31.299
    | text      = of political terror.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:31:33.500
    | text      = State Representative Melissa Hortman, a Democratic powerhouse and former House Speaker, along
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:31:39.000
    | text      = with her husband Mark, were gunned down in their Brooklyn Park home by a suspect posing
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:31:43.759
    | text      = as a police officer.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:31:45.519
    | text      = In a related attack, State Senator John Hoffman and his wife Yvette were shot multiple times,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:31:51.200
    | text      = both now clinging to life after surgery.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:31:54.119
    | text      = As the lone Democrat in the House to join Republicans, Hortman supported SSHF1, a bill
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:31:59.759
    | text      = stripping undocumented adults from eligibility for Minnesota Care, the state's low-income
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:32:05.640
    | text      = health insurance program.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:32:07.380
    | text      = This 68-65 vote, with Hortman as the decisive crossover, marked a stunning departure from
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:32:14.779
    | text      = her party's progressive rhetoric.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:32:17.119
    | text      = The Democrats decried Hortman's vote as cruel and immoral, with Representative Maria
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:32:22.619
    | text      = Aisa Perez Vega chanting, this ain't one Minnesota in protest.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:32:28.859
    | text      = Days before her murder, Hortman, physically shaking, defended her vote as a necessary
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:32:33.900
    | text      = compromise to secure a state budget in a tied 67-67 House.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:32:38.859
    | text      = I know that people will be hurt by that vote.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:32:45.740
    | text      = We worked very hard to try to get a budget deal that wouldn't include that provision.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:32:51.660
    | text      = Yet this single act of pragmatism may have sealed her fate as whispers of retribution
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:32:57.819
    | text      = swirl in the wake of her assassination.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:33:00.740
    | text      = This is absolute shit.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:33:02.819
    | text      = What did John say the vote was on this bill?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:33:05.140
    | text      = It was 68-65, right?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:33:07.539
    | text      = So if Hortman had abstained from voting, it would have been 67-65.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:33:12.000
    | text      = Or if she'd voted against it, it would have been 67-66.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:33:15.799
    | text      = It seems like whatever she did, the bill would have passed, and that her vote was more of
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:33:19.220
    | text      = a symbolic act meant to ensure cooperation from the Republicans on other parts of the
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:33:23.539
    | text      = state budget.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:33:24.539
    | text      = Because where he cuts off that thing from the news report, saying that we wanted to
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:33:30.380
    | text      = find a way to do this without this in the budget, but the GOP will not.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:33:36.400
    | text      = They made it clear they weren't going to give an inch and that they were willing to shut
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:33:39.299
    | text      = down the government if they didn't get their way.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:33:42.059
    | text      = The Minnesota House is a complete mess, even before the shooting.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:33:45.180
    | text      = In the 2024 election, the House ended up being a 67-67 split between the GOP and the DFL,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:33:51.660
    | text      = or the Democratic Farmer Labor Party.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:33:54.180
    | text      = The GOP challenged the winner of the District 40B race, Curtis Johnson, and they were successful
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:33:59.339
    | text      = in stopping him from being seated by arguments that he didn't live in his district.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:34:03.940
    | text      = A special election was scheduled, but for the time being, the GOP had a majority of
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:34:07.859
    | text      = 67-66, with the 40B seat being vacant.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:34:11.539
    | text      = It was very clear that the DFL would win that seat and it would end up in a tie, but while
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:34:16.380
    | text      = they had a temporary advantage, the GOP tried to push through all of their agenda.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:34:21.219
    | text      = In response, the DFL members boycotted the House, refusing to show up so the GOP wouldn't
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:34:25.380
    | text      = have the required number of representatives present to make a quorum.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:34:29.380
    | text      = In February of this year, the two parties reached a power sharing agreement, which sort
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:34:33.340
    | text      = of resolved things, but also clearly didn't.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:34:35.940
    | text      = Melissa Hortman was part of that negotiation for the power sharing agreement, since she
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:34:39.699
    | text      = was the former Speaker of the Minnesota House and the leader of the DFL party.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:34:44.579
    | text      = When they came to this compromise, she was part of the negotiations to form a state budget,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:34:49.139
    | text      = part of which was this unshakable GOP position that undocumented adults were to be stripped
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:34:54.239
    | text      = of eligibility for Minnesota care.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:34:57.000
    | text      = I'm not defending her choice in making that compromise, but I'm trying to illustrate that
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:01.159
    | text      = her vote is not as suspicious as Alex and Jon Bound want to make it out to be.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:06.079
    | text      = The entire narrative of this vote being part of the motivation for the shooting falls apart
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:10.480
    | text      = when you add in the other victim, Senator Jon Hoffman.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:14.039
    | text      = He voted against the bill, which wasn't as close in the Senate, and had 15 Democratic
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:18.980
    | text      = votes in favor of it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:20.719
    | text      = So if there was a means of killing these people to punish them for going against the Democrats,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:26.320
    | text      = there's 15 senators in the Minnesota Senate that should have been targets before Hoffman.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:34.039
    | text      = Jon Bound says that Hortman's pragmatic vote may have sealed her fate and that whispers
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:37.739
    | text      = of retribution are in the air, but he's the one who's doing the whispering.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:42.880
    | text      = They're creating this like, oh, the streets are talking, and then pretending that they're
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:47.559
    | text      = just neutral observers covering this story.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:50.460
    | text      = It's horse shit.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:51.460
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:52.460
    | text      = Yeah, I wouldn't be Jon Bound near me.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:56.860
    | text      = Like listening to that, I threw my hockey gloves to the ground.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:00.900
    | text      = That shit was done.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock

    | timestamp = 00:36:01.900
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:02.900
    | text      = Time to have a hockey fight.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:04.559
    | text      = I don't know how else to describe what just happened there.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:06.940
    | text      = I'm the sensible information person here.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:11.179
    | text      = Gloves off.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:12.179

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = Let's go.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:14.179
    | text      = Now, you know what you're doing here, Dick.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:15.179
    | text      = You know exactly what you're doing.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:16.539
    | text      = You are doing it on purpose.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:17.980
    | text      = I know it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:19.139
    | text      = Now it's got to be resolved one way or the other.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:22.300
    | text      = So Alex continues playing this Jon Bound report, and I honestly think that it's just repackaging
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:30.260
    | text      = Alex's stuff with a different person's voice.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:33.940
    | text      = No official motive has been confirmed, but the No Kings flyers found in Bolter's vehicle
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:39.739
    | text      = tie him directly to the raucous anti-Trump rallies planned across Minnesota and the rest
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:44.420
    | text      = of the country.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:45.900
    | text      = We don't have any raucous.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:47.500
    | text      = Go fuck yourself.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:48.860
    | text      = There were some flyers that said No Kings.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:50.900
    | text      = And the plot thickens as Bolter has been identified as a 2019 appointee to the governor's workforce
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:56.659
    | text      = development board by Minnesota governor Tim Walz.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:37:01.860
    | text      = My good friend and colleague, Speaker Melissa Hortman and her husband Mark, were shot and
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:37:06.420
    | text      = killed early this morning in what appears to be a politically motivated assassination.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:37:11.219
    | text      = And as Trump's military parade marking the US Army's 250th anniversary begins to roll
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:37:16.420
    | text      = out, the left's refusal to cancel these rallies reeks of hypocrisy and cognitive dissonance,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:37:22.860
    | text      = preaching peace while aggressively rallying against Kings exposes the fractured ideology
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:37:29.539
    | text      = that Hortman's vote and her death have laid bare.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:37:32.460
    | text      = There's a shocking and disgusting irony to that.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:37:39.340
    | text      = The dissonance of the left doing protests.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:37:44.380
    | text      = The dissonance of this, this kind of packaging, this kind of reporting as a means of running
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:37:52.739
    | text      = cover for a political assassin is dark.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:37:58.260
    | text      = You know, I'm trying to invert things, right?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:38:01.500
    | text      = Like I'm not screaming at you because we're in this room together.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:38:06.699
    | text      = And that makes me want to scream very, very loudly for a long period of time.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:38:10.739
    | text      = I know.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:38:11.739
    | text      = And I can feel it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:38:12.739
    | text      = I can feel it to you because doing it to you wouldn't help.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
